technical.summary: Mixed signals with strong volume spike and PPO crossover offset by bearish MACD, long-term downtrend positioning, and overbought stochastic conditions; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 91 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with fear-zone market conditions offering potential contrarian opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and conflicted (1 small purchase vs 2 small sales), while news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 207.56 crisis regime, FOMC event just passed) creates severe near-term headwinds despite 91-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), PPO bullish crossover, and supertrend alignment provide technical momentum entry signal in fear-zone market conditions offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish MACD histogram, price below both 200-EMA and 50-SMA, thick ichimoku cloud resistance, overbought stochRSI, zero fundamental support, weak ADX conviction, and macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 207.56) create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Volume spike and PPO crossover provide technical momentum, but macro crisis regime (VIX 207.56, inverted yield curve, FOMC aftermath) and bearish MACD/price-below-200EMA structure create overwhelming headwinds that negate contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Macro stress environment combined with overbought stochRSI and thick ichimoku resistance creates high probability of pullback or reversal before swing target; zero fundamental support leaves no conviction anchor.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 4 other IT holdings in 30-position portfolio creates sector concentration risk; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in high-volatility sector during crisis macro conditions.
